Hero is using 102 value combos, which
will play very well against BU's likely
flatting range and 204 bluffs, which are
the best of the rest as always in the polar
model.

Needless to say, Hero is folding a lot to
a 4-bet here, depending on how much of
his value range he wishes to continue
with. We are assuming for now,
however, that BU is going to overfold
substantially to 3-bets and so any times
we do get 4-bet bluffed are outweighed
by the EV from fold equity in the first
place. Of course, if Villain were more
balanced or we thought he was likely to
notice and adjust to our strategy, then
